slides.title: Command Post User?
slides.html:
• When you are using WinTAK you are very likely a command post / HQ user.
  • You are responsible for managing and creating feeds.

slides.title: Creating Feeds
slides.html: • Create feeds for either delivering your plans or to start a continuous sharing of information.

slides.title: The Data Sync Home - Overlay Manager
slides.html: • Tap the Data Sync New feed symbol to start.

slides.title: Creating Feed - Options
slides.html:
• New feed creation form
  • On the next pages are more detailed descriptions

slides.title: Name your Feed
slides.html: • Name: Be descriptive. The example name points out that the feed contains a plan for logistics.

slides.title: Choose Group
slides.html:
• Next, tap the Group selector to choose which group can access your feed.
  • Default value uses default (all TAK users)

slides.title: Choose Default Role
slides.html:
• Choose what suits your purpose best.
  • Subscriber means that all users can send and read from a feed.
  • Read-only means that only owners can send to the feed.

slides.title: Password
slides.html:
• Optionally, you can define a password for your feed to restrict access.
  • You should carefully consider when to use a password.

slides.title: Describe your Feed
slides.html: • By tapping Description, you may describe your feed. That helps.

slides.title: Hashtags
slides.html: • Optionally, you could write some hashtags for your feed. That could help in analyzing data on your server.

slides.title: New Feed Created!
slides.html:
• Create feed!
  • People from your server can now subscribe to your feed.
